messages:
miso: posted a 10s clip  meet noodle, our ferret. he insists on wearing tiny spectacles and attempts a skateboard run. no humans were harmed. clip: https://imgur.com/a/ferretclip 
tara: the tiny spectacles are a whole mood :laughing: 
ade: this is illegal levels of cute. he looks like a professor on a lunch break 
clare: can we sleeve him into a tiny hoodie pls. also noodle has skateboard skills? impressive 
miso: he practiced with a toenail as a prop. 2/10 on technique, 11/10 on charm. added slow-mo gif 
tara: poll: give him an office nickname? options: `Professor Noodle`, `SkateFerret`, `Mini Specs` 
ade: :thumbsup: Professor Noodle 
clare: :thumbsup: Mini Specs 
miso: tie-breaker vote from the owner: Professor Noodle wins  new header photo for slack? :camera_with_flash: 
opsbot: Reminder: Bringing animals to the office requires advance sign-off and the pet registry form: https://intranet/fw/pet-policy. Also ensure common-area food is sealed (allergies). 
tara: noted! will sign the form before bringing him in next week. he may request a tiny whiteboard for trick planning :white_small_square: 
ade: follow-up question  does anyone have ferret-safe treats recs? I will be the official snack supplier :raised_hands: 
clare: banana slices are fine in tiny amounts, and ferret-safe chews from the pet store. avoid grapes/chocolate 
miso: thanks! will compile a snack checklist and schedule a "Noodle appreciation 10-min" next Friday during standup for morale :party_popper:
